g.text: A page table in four levels
Each table has 512 entries and fits in one page. A branch that holds no mapped page is simply absent,
so an empty address space costs a handful of pages of tables.
Flat, one entry per page of 128 TiB: 2^35 entries, 256 GB per process.
As a tree: the shell's tables take 60 KB; a browser with 1.5 TB of address space, 8 MB.
The price: a translation that misses every cache is four memory reads before the one the program asked for.
